newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb kills eight, wounds 30 in Algeria - report.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills eight, wounds 30 in Algeria - report.

text.p: Eight people were killed and 30 wounded when suspected Moslem guerrillas detonated a bomb beneath a passenger train, an Algerian newspaper said on Saturday.

The bomb went off on Thursday morning under the train linking Algiers to the western city of Oran, said El Watan newspaper. The explosion occurred some 20 km (12 miles) south of the Algerian capital, it added
The bomb was the latest in a series of attacks against people on trains and cars that the authorities blame on Moslem guerrillas.

The Algerian paper Liberte said on Saturday that security forces killed five Moslem guerrillas shortly after they detonated a home-made bomb on Thursday at a market in the coastal town of Zeralda, 60 km (40 miles) west of Algiers.
There were no casualties from the explosion.
At least 50,000 people have died since violence erupted in Algeria after the authorities in January 1992 scrapped a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
